verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a dedicated HTTP API for sending event data from sources to destinations, plus a Pixel API for GET-based tracking, confirming a server-to-server ingestion path (rudderstack-docs-21, -56, -54, -33). However, the evidence pack never details authentication mechanisms (write keys, tokens) or explicit delivery guarantees (retries, at-least-once semantics) for this API. Missing for 10: explicit authentication scheme documentation, explicit delivery/retry guarantee documentation, and independent hands-on confirmation of server-to-server reliability.
